ICS 29.060.01; 29.120.10ETD 14New Standard from Last Update.NATIONAL FOREWORDThis Indian Standard (Part 2/Sec 1) (First Revision) which is identical with IEC 61084-2-1 : 2017 'Cable trunking systems and cable ducting systems for electrical installations - Part 2-1: Particular requirements - Cable trunking systems and cable ducting systems intended for mounting on walls and ceilings' issued by the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on the recommendation of the Electrical Wiring Accessories Sectional Committee and approval of the Electrotechnical Division Council.This standard was first published in 2001. The first revision of this standard has been undertaken to align it with the latest version of IEC 618084-2-1 to make pace with the latest developments that have taken place at international level.

NATIONAL FOREWORD
This Indian Standard (Part 2/Sec 1) (First Revision) which is identical with IEC 61084-2-1 : 2017 'Cable trunking systems and cable ducting systems for electrical installations - Part 2-1: Particular requirements - Cable trunking systems and cable ducting systems intended for mounting on walls and ceilings' issued by the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on the recommendation of the Electrical Wiring Accessories Sectional Committee and approval of the Electrotechnical Division Council.
This standard was first published in 2001. The first revision of this standard has been undertaken to align it with the latest version of IEC 618084-2-1 to make pace with the latest developments that have taken place at international level.
